explanation: Matches erdosproblems.com/1176. For every graph with chromatic cardinal ℵ₁ there is an edge colouring with ℵ₁ colours such that, for every vertex colouring with countably many colours, some vertex colour class contains edges of every edge colour (both endpoints in the class). Universe handling is consistent: the colour types live in Type, and V's chromatic cardinal is compared with aleph 1 in V's universe. Only consistency is known (Hajnal–Komjáth), so stating it affirmatively as open is appropriate.
